brief: Copy of an array with one value replaced
description: Return a new array that is array with the value at index replaced by value, leaving array unchanged (it is named with_at because with is a reserved word). Negative index counts from the end, as in at. An index out of range is an error.

parameters.description: Zero-based index, or negative from the end.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The value to put at index.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: A new array with the value at index replaced.
